name: semk-services
description: Orquestador de desarrollo: instala y levanta los 4 microservicios de SEMK a la vez

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix sesion-service && npm install --prefix feedback-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -n AUTH,SESION,FEEDBACK,GATEWAY -c green,magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix sesion-service" "npm run dev --prefix feedback-service" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway"
